name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/are/simulation/gui/server/graphql/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_async_decorator: create a decorator that wraps a synchronous function to run it in a threadpool for FastAPI GraphQL endpoints
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_graphql_resolver: build a GraphQL resolver function and wrap it with make_async to enable concurrent execution in FastAPI
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.refactor_sync_resolver: refactor a synchronous GraphQL resolver to use the make_async decorator for non-blocking threadpool execution
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_make_async: review the make_async decorator to understand how it uses starlette run_in_threadpool for concurrency
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.test_make_async: test the make_async decorator by wrapping a slow synchronous function and verifying it returns an awaitable coroutine

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.execute_app_tool: execute a tool within an app by providing app name, tool name, and JSON kwargs parameters
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.set_scenario: set the active scenario for a simulation session by providing scenario and session IDs
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.play_pause_stop: control simulation playback by starting, pausing, or stopping a scenario for a given session
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.add_scenario_event: add a new event to the scenario with app, function, parameters, and predecessor event IDs
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.import_trace: import a scenario from a trace JSON string and optionally replay the logs after importing

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.export_trace_data: export trace data for a simulation session with validation decision and annotation metadata
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.export_annotated_trace_data: export annotated trace data with violation categories and annotator details for a simulation session
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.report_bug: report a bug for a simulation session with scenario ID, reporter name, and context
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.get_huggingface_scenarios: list available scenarios in a Huggingface dataset by name, config, and split
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.get_interactive_scenarios_tree: retrieve the interactive scenarios tree from a JSON file configured via environment variable

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.save_attachment_to_disk: save a base64-encoded attachment to disk and return its URL and file size
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.clear_graphql_cache: clear the GraphQL cache entries for a given session ID
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.update_graphql_cache: check if an object has changed and update the GraphQL cache with its new state
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.process_attachments: process a list of attachments into GraphQL-compatible objects with URLs and sizes
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.get_world_logs_for_graphql: convert a list of agent world logs into GraphQL-compatible log objects with attachments

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.convert_app_to_graphql: convert an App object to AppForGraphQL with all its tools for GraphQL exposure
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.extract_app_tools: extract all agent, user, env, and data tools from an App as AppToolForGraphQL objects
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.convert_scenario_to_graphql: convert a Scenario object to ScenarioForGraphQL including nested apps and GUI config
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_default_gui_config: create a default ScenarioGUIConfigForGraphQL with show_timestamps set to false
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_agent_log_types: review the AgentLogTypeForGraphQL enum to understand all supported agent log categories
